_comment: Per-contract-crate line-coverage floors. This file is the single source of truth for BOTH scripts/run_contract_coverage.sh (which crates get measured) and scripts/check-coverage-thresholds.sh (which floors are enforced). It mirrors the shape of .github/wasm-budgets.json on purpose so both gates are read the same way.
_units: All percentages are LINE coverage (lines hit / instrumentable lines), not region or function coverage. cargo-llvm-cov's `Lines Cover` column is the source of truth.
_update_process: To move a floor: run scripts/run_contract_coverage.sh, read the `lines_pct` it recorded in coverage/coverage-summary.json, and set min_lines_pct to that value (rounded DOWN, so a floor is never above what was actually measured). Only ever raise a floor together with the tests that justify it, and say so in the PR description.
